purpose: Guarded migration plan: Stage-33 impact candidates are ordered into capsule waves, steps, gate bindings and invariants before any future runtime move.

waves.name: Meta-Kohärenz und Planungswelle
waves.focus: Stage-27 bis Stage-34 Metaebenen selbst stabil halten
waves.universal_property: The meta stack is the universal audit object for later moves.
waves.naturality_requirement: Impact-derived and gate-derived planning must name the same allowed move.

waves.name: Topologie-/Prägarben-Datenwelle
waves.focus: i18n, CSV und Dokumentsektionen nur entlang Kontext- und Restriktionsgesetzen verändern
waves.universal_property: Local sections glue to canonical semantics after context restriction.

waves.name: Prompt-/Input-Morphismuswelle
waves.focus: Prompt- und CLI-Rohtext weiter aus Legacy-Fassaden lösen
waves.universal_property: Raw command sections canonically map into semantic sheaves.
waves.naturality_requirement: Raw-to-canonical naturality must commute for each prompt context.

waves.name: Workflow-/Universal-Gluing-Welle
waves.focus: reta.py als Workflow-Fassade auf universelle Konstruktionen reduzieren
waves.universal_property: The table workflow is the universal glued object from semantic sections and column selection.
waves.naturality_requirement: Workflow gluing before/after compatibility projection yields the same table section.

waves.name: Table-Core-State-Welle
waves.focus: Table runtime/state/prepare ownership enger in TableCoreCapsule führen
waves.universal_property: The global table section and explicit state sections are two projections of the same object.
waves.naturality_requirement: Runtime-state projection remains natural under prepare/filter/wrap morphisms.

waves.name: Generated-Relation-Welle
waves.universal_property: Generated relations are endomorphisms of table sections with sheaf-state sync.
waves.naturality_requirement: Generated-column state sync remains independent of legacy entry path.

waves.name: Output-Rendering- und Paritätswelle
waves.focus: Renderer-Funktoren und Normalisierung weiter von Legacy-Ausgabe entkoppeln
waves.universal_property: Rendered outputs are functorial images of table sections, compared through normalization.
waves.naturality_requirement: Render-then-normalize and legacy-normalize paths stay observationally equivalent.

diagrams.text:
ArchitectureMigrationBundle
├─ MigrationWaveSpec
│  └─ ordered capsule waves M0..M6
├─ MigrationStepSpec
│  └─ Stage-33 candidate → action → target owner → category/functor/naturality
├─ MigrationGateBindingSpec
│  └─ step → regression gates → concrete commands
├─ MigrationInvariantSpec
│  └─ wave → diagrams/laws/natural transformations that must keep commuting
└─ MigrationValidationSpec
   └─ candidate coverage, gate binding, diagram/naturality references and wave order
diagrams.mermaid:
```mermaid flowchart TD Impact[ArchitectureImpactBundle
sources + candidates + gates] --> Plan[ArchitectureMigrationBundle] Plan --> Waves[ordered migration waves] Plan --> Steps[MigrationStepSpec] Steps --> Gates[MigrationGateBindingSpec] Steps --> Invariants[MigrationInvariantSpec] Gates --> Validation[MigrationValidationSpec] Invariants --> Validation Validation --> Future[future runtime extraction
only after gates commute] ```

planned_after_stage_33: Turn Stage-33 impact candidates into a concrete, ordered migration plan instead of leaving them as a flat risk list.
Make each future move stufenweise and kapselweise: wave, step, target owner, functor route, natural transformation, diagrams and gates.
Preserve the adjusted architecture paradigm by treating later code movement as a naturality-preserving migration, not a direct rewrite.
